content:
rachel-sec: Quick sync 1 - proposing a Just-In-Time SIEM export workflow for triage + incidents. Goal: enable scoped raw access but reduce blast radius + automatic expiry. Need feedback on RBAC names, unwrap TTL, and legal hold integration.

devin-infra: +1. technical preference: per-export CMK grant + retire after TTL. Don't hand out Decrypt in long-lived roles.

sam-soc: SOC asks: 1) preview mode (counts only) before export, 2) default work window 72h, 3) ability to escalate with audit trail.

taylor-oncall: For incidents we need fast path: ticket created -> auto-notify sec lead -> grant issued after 2 approvals OR an oncall+sec lead pair. 15min notification buffer sounds good.

ana-legal: Legal: legal-hold must override TTL and move data to restricted archive with immutable flag. Need chain-of-custody metadata and a link to the matter ID.

rachel-sec: Draft policy sketch below, pls comment inline.

# policy fields
export_id: string
requestor: string
datasets: [pcap,auth,app_logs]
preview_only: bool
export_ttl: 30d   # default max
work_window: 72h  # typical SOC working window
kms_unwrap_ttl: 8h  # unwrap lifetime for decryptionoles: soc:export_reader, soc:escalator, sec:breakglass_admin
legal_hold: bool
chain_of_custody: {ticket_id, approvers, timestamps, signature_hash}

rachel-sec: Rules idea: - preview_only true -> return counts and sample hashes only, no raw. - Default export_ttl=30d, but if dataset=pcap or sensitivity=high then export_ttl<=7d and require automated redaction before storage. - kms_unwrap_ttl short (8h) but `soc:escalator` can re-request a grant for +24h with documented approvers. - breakglass requires sec lead + legal or sec lead + oncall.

devin-infra: Implementation notes: Use GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext and CMK grants to the ephemeral role used by export-runner. Create an EventBridge job to retire grants after kms_unwrap_ttl. Store audit blob to s3://audit-write/exports/{export_id}.signed and emit SHA256 into our primary audit index.

sam-soc: Suggest role names: `soc:export_reader`, `soc:escalation` (can request extend), `sec:breakglass_admin` (raw-only view for 7d). Also add `soc:preview_viewer` for counts-only.

taylor-oncall: Add to runbook: 1) create ticket with template (include filter, timebox, justification), 2) request export, 3) approvals, 4) infra issues grant, 5) export-runner writes objects with metadata, 6) auto-notify thread + webhook to ticket.

ana-legal: The ticket template must include Matter ID, preservation flag checkbox, and attestation that PII was reviewed. If preservation toggled, export moves to legal-archive and TTL disabled.

devin-infra: For tamper evidence: sign the audit blob with a KMS asymmetric key, upload signature + payload. Keep signature record in the index. Any mutation changes hash and is detectable. I can prototype terraform for grant lifecycle.

sam-soc: Operational request: `preview_mode` endpoint returns counts by filter and a sample of 10 de-identified events. That cuts down on accidental huge exports.

taylor-oncall: Also add a cost check: if estimated export size > 50GB auto-reject and require sec lead review.

rachel-sec: Questions: - Is kms_unwrap_ttl=8h okay? SOC wants 72h window but infra recommends short unwrap. My proposal: short unwrap + allow documented re-issues via escalation role. - Who owns retiring automation?

devin-infra: I'll own initial automation and hand off to infra-sre. Re-issue flow requires Jira ticket link and recorded approvers. Short unwrap reduces risk if export credentials leak.

ana-legal: One more: chain_of_custody.signature_hash must include ticket_id + approvers + s3 object listing and be immutable. Legal will review schema.

sam-soc: One UX nit: add `reason` free text limited to 280 chars and enforce structured categories (investigation, incident, compliance, vendor-request).

taylor-oncall: Add ephemeral Slack channel + thread auto-created for each export so triagers can collaborate and link notes.

ops-bot: CI: starting `infra/export-grants` deployment - 4 jobs queued.

rachel-sec: Plan: I'll assemble RFC + runbook + terraform snippets. Target: RFC out by Tue, pilot with SOC next week, prod rollout in 3 weeks. Tagging reviewers: @devin-infra @sam-soc @ana-legal.

sam-soc: ack, will prepare sample triage ticket template.

devin-infra: ack, will prototype grant retire lambda and signing step.

rachel-sec: Thanks. If anyone wants to pair on the signature/hash design ping me.
